answer: A beacon check plus a compute heartbeat stops fakes. Each agent must answer a random check with a heartbeat proving work; idle copies cannot hide in a lagoon. Sampling is unpredictable, duplicate heartbeats are rejected, dispersing the nebula of clones. Forging 100 identities needs 100 heartbeats at 20 credits each, 2,000 per window, lost on failure, and costs spiral per identity. An honest agent pays one heartbeat and keeps rewards undiluted.
